stable_baseline_manifest.scope: Only this ordinary pre-existing manifest JSON was read; no member payload was opened.

verified_static_contracts: BASE is exact ff448447a135d31314f7a0bd88e6ddd8ed449bfb; both source and independent restore clone must start there, and restore must be clean. Publication requires the expected push URL and initially empty staged index.

NEW=[] and tracked worktree changes must be exactly the six declared fronts. Their exact old BASE bytes must remain as a unique suffix. The delta inventory comprises those fronts plus every actual file present under the new stage; no default HF source or old scientific run is selected for alteration.

Execution status is obtained from actual helper/launch records only after non-running closure and verified cleanup. Both pass and not_pass are allowed; scientific pass requires both statuses pass. The independent actual review and closure must agree with that outcome, and publication receipts retain execution_outcome separately from publication success.

Known incomplete/partial seal statuses do not invent identities. Every new-stage .npz/.png/.gif/.gz/.csv/.zip must have an original helper-window output seal and matching current stat size, otherwise publication stops. The publisher never rehashes or decodes those scientific/media payloads.

Ordinary source/JSON/MD/log files are SHA256 hashed; if covered by the producer output seal, the new hash/size must equal it. Old manifest entries are inherited intact except the six fronts and new-stage delta entries. Manifest membership/count assumptions match the current stable21236-entry baseline.

The exact delta rows plus manifest are staged, checked and committed. Main is pushed with ordinary git push, not force. The actual remote main hash must equal the newly committed HEAD and source must be clean.

The independent clone fetches and fast-forwards from BASE. Restore HEAD must equal the new commit. The same exact delta list is checked there: ordinary file SHA/size, scientific/media stat against the original helper seal, and a clean worktree. No full historical payload verification, numerical rerun or new restore qualification is claimed.

A publication exception records its actual phase, any already-known commit/remote fields and error before propagating. The script does not roll back, delete evidence, force-push, recreate closed science or retry itself.
Only stdlib/file/Git operations occur in the source. There are no HF/NumPy/PIL imports, array loads, solver/F/T/HP calls, plotting, tests or external scientific process launches.
acceptable_limits_and_preconditions: The script remains a future candidate: this review did not read current run_001, launch/closure/actual-review records, scientific arrays or media, and asserts no current scientific or publication PASS.

NOT_PASS publication is possible only when actual cleanup is verified and every scientific/media file selected for the delta has its original-window identity seal. Missing seal or absent closure/review stops; no late payload identity is manufactured.

published_and_incrementally_restored_pass means publication/delta restoration passed. It does not override execution_outcome=not_pass, transfer independent-reference/contact/HF5 qualification or claim full archived-evidence replay.

The stable old21236-entry manifest is checked here as ordinary metadata, not a renewed check of those21236 payloads. Git transfer/checkout is not a new scientific evaluation or explicit payload SHA256 audit.

The publisher includes only files already copied under the formal stage before its stage_files scan. If root intends publish.py and this static review as delivered author context, copy their exact ordinary bytes there before that scan; external author files are not imported automatically. The final publication receipt itself is written externally and requires the normal later receipt archiving step if it is to be committed.
